    s = input[0]
    k = input[1]
    res = ''
    i = 0
    while i < len(s):
        total = 0
        j = 0

        res += chr(97 + (total % 26))
        i += k

def oracle(input):
    nums = input[0]
    queries = input[1]
    n = len(nums)
    marked = [False] * n
    total = 0
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        total += nums[i]
        i += 1
    order = []
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        order.append((nums[i], i))
        i += 1
    order.sort()
    p = 0
    ans = []
    qi = 0
    while qi < len(queries):
        idx = queries[qi][0]
        k = queries[qi][1]
        if not marked[idx]:
            marked[idx] = True
            total -= nums[idx]
        while p < n and marked[order[p][1]]:
            p += 1
        c = 0
        while c < k and p < n:
            j = order[p][1]
            if not marked[j]:
                marked[j] = True
                total -= nums[j]
                c += 1
            p += 1
            while p < n and marked[order[p][1]]:
                p += 1
        ans.append(total)
        qi += 1
    return ans

title: find-mirror-score-of-a-string
oracle_code:
def oracle(s):
    stacks = [None] * 26
    score = 0
    i = 0
    while i < len(s):
        c = s[i]
        x = ord(c) - 97
        m = 25 - x
        stack = stacks[m]
        if stack is not None and len(stack) > 0:
            j = stack[-1]
            del stack[-1]
            score += i - j
        else:
            own = stacks[x]
            if own is None:
                stacks[x] = [i]
            else:
                own.append(i)
        i += 1
    return score
